# CleanMarkdown

> Fast local Markdown viewer and editor (v1.0.5) with a clean reading mode, raw Markdown editing, high-resolution image inspection, lightweight math preview, vector PDF export, Web Companion PWA, and 6-language UI (`de`, `en`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, `ru`). Runs 100% offline with zero cloud egress.

## Canonical links

- GitHub: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown
- Product Skill: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/SKILL.md
- Compatibility Pointer: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/llm.txt
- German Documentation: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/README_DE.md
- Spanish Documentation: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/README_es.md
- Security Policy: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- CI Contract: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/docs/CI-CONTRACT.md
- Umbrella Ecosystem: https://github.com/open-bricks

## What it does

- Two-tab workspace: clean rendered reading view and raw Markdown editor with optional scroll synchronization.
- PDF export with timestamp-based filenames, vector page layout, and active-source overwrite protection.
- Session export/import via `cleanmarkdown-session-v1.json` for local handoff to companion apps (`web_companion/` and `flutter_port/`).
- Interactive high-resolution image preview dialog with Zoom (`+` / `-` / `Fit` / `1:1`), Clipboard Copying, and image metadata.
- Automatic `<figure>` and `<figcaption>` generation while preserving custom anchor URLs and targets.
- Lightweight math preview for `$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)`, and `\[...\]` with code-block protection.
- 6-language UI (`de`, `en`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, `ru`) with light and dark theme (143/143 verified translation keys).
- Strict UTF-8 file opening: invalid UTF-8 input is rejected without replacing the active document or corrupting bytes.
- Offline Web Companion PWA (`web_companion/`) and Flutter mobile port (`flutter_port/`) for Android/iOS.
- Local offline use — 100% Zero-Egress, Non-Elevation, no accounts, no telemetry, no cloud sync.

## Machine-Readable Setup & Verification

### 1. Prerequisites

- Python `3.10`, `3.11`, `3.12`, or `3.13`
- Runtime dependencies in `requirements.txt` (`PySide6>=6.5.0,!=6.12.0`, `markdown>=3.4.0`)
- Optional test/lint tools: `pytest>=9.1.1`, `ruff>=0.9.0`, `Pillow>=10.0`, Node.js `22+` (for `tests/test_web_renderer.cjs`)

### 2. Installation Command (Isolated Environment)

```bash
python -m venv .venv
# Linux/macOS: source .venv/bin/activate
# Windows PowerShell: .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt pytest ruff Pillow
```

### 3. Verification Commands

```bash
ruff check .
python -m py_compile main.py translator.py manage_translations.py generate_store_screenshots.py launcher.py
node --test tests/test_web_renderer.cjs
python manage_translations.py --check
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen python main.py --smoke-test
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 python main.py --self-test
python -m pytest -ra -v
```

### 4. Minimal Usage Example

```bash
python main.py README.md
```

## Important files

- `SKILL.md` — product skill for AI assistants (safe commands, exit codes, boundaries, session JSON schema).
- `main.py` — PySide6 desktop application entry point, UI workspace, `--smoke-test`, `--self-test`, and AST pipeline.
- `translator.py` / `manage_translations.py` — 6-language i18n runtime and `--check` parity gate (`de`, `en`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, `ru`).
- `web_companion/` — zero-egress vanilla ES6 Progressive Web App companion.
- `flutter_port/` — Flutter Android/iOS mobile port.
- `tests/` — pytest suite (292 collected: 291 passed, 1 skipped on Windows without symlink privilege; plus 6 Node renderer security tests).
- `EXPORTFORMAT.md` — `cleanmarkdown-session-v1.json` contract (`cleanmarkdown-bundle-v1.zip` reserved).

## Audience

- Writers and developers who want a distraction-free local Markdown viewer and editor.
- Users who need PDF export without a cloud account or internet connection.
- Developers evaluating local-first PySide6 desktop apps with Web PWA and Flutter companions.
- Privacy-conscious users who need their Markdown files to stay on their machine.
- AI assistants (Claude, Codex, Gemini) helping users set up or operate CleanMarkdown locally.
